note: D4 an offer past Content.DRAFT_SLOTS is wild: wide_draft asks for four, the list names three roles, and the fourth slot rolls over the whole universe - anchor_roots, bark, no tag the flarekeeper holds. The record is d4_affinity_slot draft with one slot added and its first three offers are identical (moss_filter, sun_flare+, pollen_burst): the roll spends exactly one main-rng draw per slot in order, so widening the draft appends a draw instead of reshuffling the ones before it. What this board does NOT hold is a starved slot (every slot here has several candidates), so the padding half of the rule - a slot whose list is empty still spends its draw and yields nothing, the number of main-rng draws being the slot count and never the kit, the grafts or the pool - is pinned by d4_starved_slot.json instead
